# Journal Recommendations

> Topic: EEG neurofeedback for mild cognitive impairment (MCI)
> Hypothesis: Higher baseline beta1 relative power and lower alpha node strength predict responder status in aMCI (AUC > 0.5), in the direction reported by MarcosMartinezEtAl2026.
> Date: 2026-10-26

## Selection Criteria

Fit with non-pharmacological MCI trials and neurotechnology, prior NF/MCI publications from the collection, open access, and a mix of ambition levels.

## Submission Strategy

Pre-register the protocol (and consider a protocol paper in Trials, as MarlatsEtAl2019 did); submit the main results to the aspirational venue first, then cascade to JNER, Frontiers in Aging Neuroscience and Clinical Interventions in Aging.
